name: Repeater Item reads the item its enclosing component instance carries; one outside any Repeater or Run Tasks template has no Item Id and says so on the error channel; Remove Completed with nothing waiting is Unchanged
because: foreachactions.ts `itemId`: "Id of the record this repeated item was created for"; foreachitem.ts: "a node that is not inside a Repeater or Run Tasks template at all now says so, once" (the handle's `errors`, outside the trace); `unchanged`: "Fires when no removal was waiting".
